integrity: Definitions, quantifiers, parity cases, maximum-set classification, and optimal-coloring uniqueness were reconstructed from the stated graph. Primary full text was inspected for the initiating parameter, its product inequality, and the regular-bipartite comparison. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd crown graphs. The finite checker covers only n=3,5,7,9 and is a stress test, not the infinite proof. The even-n crown values follow from a published odd-degree regular-bipartite result and are not claimed as new.
title: Odd independence and strong odd coloring of odd crown graphs
